normalized_text: welcome to a new video in the proofs of prophethood series this one is going to be really short i'm just going to read a few verses from suratul hajj and maybe a little bit commentary at the end first of all i want you to keep in mind that the chapter that i'm going to be reading from was revealed in mecca however the verses that i'm going to be focusing on specifically were revealed during the migration to medina they were in such a weak state that they had to leave their homes they had to flee their homes to seek safety in the town of medina the verse states the following permission to fight has been given to those who are being fought because they were wronged and indeed allah is competent to give them victory they are those who have been evicted from their homes without right only because they say our lord is allah and were it not that allah checks the people some by means of others there would have been demolished monasteries churches synagogues and mosques in which the name of allah is much mentioned and allah will surely support those who support him indeed allah is powerful and exalted in might and there are those who if we give them authority in the land establish prayer and give zakah and enjoy what is right and forbid what is wrong and to allah belongs the outcome of all matters the verses include a prophecy not only of muslims establishing their prayers and their alms but much more than that it focuses on muslims being given authority on the lands and remember this prophecy was made when the muslims were at their weakest state that's pretty much it for this video i'll see you guys in the next one i got to
